email_body:
Hello,

Speculative enquiry about graduate or junior civil design and documentation support at Osborn Consulting Engineers. I read your careers page on 4 October 2026 inviting graduates to reach out, found no dated junior vacancy, and am contacting admin@osbornconsulting.com.au as published.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. Available for office, site, regional and FIFO work, and open to discussing relocation to Southeast Queensland.

Your multi-office civil work across Brisbane, Ipswich, the Gold Coast and regional Queensland is the consulting start I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so I am looking for mentoring on drawings and delivery.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am sending a speculative enquiry about graduate or junior civil design and documentation support at Osborn Consulting Engineers. I read your people and careers page on 4 October 2026 inviting graduates and undergraduates to get in touch, and I could not verify a dated junior vacancy, so I am writing to admin@osbornconsulting.com.au as published for resume and cover letter submissions.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From April to September 2019 I was project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt on a community hall renovation, coordinating crews and checking work against drawings. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was field engineer at Grand Travaux on residential subdivision finishing works, assisting with inspections, materials tracking and progress reports.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site, regional and FIFO work, and open to discussing relocation to your Brisbane, Ipswich, Gold Coast or regional offices. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so I am looking for mentoring on civil drawings and delivery. I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
